contract_cases.trigger: Source-less local package shares advisory name/version
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Source absence identifies an inventory-local member, not a globally identified path artifact or crates.io release.

contract_cases.trigger: Custom registry shares crates.io package name/version
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Known distinct source is an identity non-match; version membership is not-evaluated and component safety stays unknown.
Preserve Git source spelling; neither a registry alias nor commit-ancestry support follows.
Do not invoke Rust version comparison for a different ecosystem.
Alias candidate remains unresolved; do not lowercase.
Alias candidate remains unresolved; do not replace underscores or hyphens.
Release identity keeps exact version spelling, including build metadata; evaluate all matching release occurrences.
Both inventory and advisory require identical explicit fixture scope for any synthetic positive.

contract_cases.trigger: Missing advisories or empty affected list
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: No source-scope hit proves neither feed completeness nor overall safety; emit explicit coverage summary, not invented package/advisory negatives.

contract_cases.trigger: Mirrored advisory with shared upstream lineage
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Keep issuer/source revision and claim occurrence identity; explicit common lineage is one declared origin, not an independent vote.
Membership can be replayed for a retained prior revision; withdrawn current-use applicability is unknown with inactive state, not excluded.

contract_cases.trigger: Included version with unknown required platform
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Keep included interval result separately from unknown required platform/configuration and unknown deployed presence.

contract_cases.trigger: Excluded supported interval plus unsupported sibling
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: If every supported branch excludes and another branch is unsupported, union membership is unknown. A supported positive instead establishes union inclusion unless input parsing fails.
Retain every exact candidate tuple and raw occurrence selector; do not pick by ordinal.
Explicit registry source can disambiguate; unresolved identity does not imply absence.

Exact source-qualified registry token resolves only that exact tuple. Git tokens whose precision differs from package source remain unsupported-source-resolution with candidates; do not label valid Cargo encoding malformed or dangling.
Only a syntactically supported token with no exact candidates is dangling; retain it and set graph coverage incomplete.
Reject a repeated exact raw (name,version,source-or-null) tuple. Two sources or versions are distinct tuples.
Require integer lock version 4 exactly; other versions are explicit unsupported input, not invalid Cargo as a whole.
Reject package replace and nonempty patch.unused before producing successful complete output. Empty patch.unused may be accepted without creating a member.
Preserve dependency occurrences and enumerate bounded simple paths using a per-path visited set. A global visited set must not discard distinct diamond paths.
Depth, per-target path count or total expansion exhaustion marks witness coverage incomplete. A found witness remains valid; no missing witness proves absence after truncation.
No root witness means unreachable-in-this-lock-graph only after complete resolved traversal. A disconnected member is still evaluated.
Dependency key includes parent member and raw dependency ordinal. Repeated endpoints are not duplicate occurrence identities.
Convert UTF-8 byte boundaries to Unicode scalar indices; do not count graphemes or UTF-16 units.

contract_cases.trigger: CRLF source or escaped TOML lexical text
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Golden checks must establish whether toml::Spanned includes the lexical quotes. Publish actual raw span and decoded value separately; never guess quote inclusion.
Whitespace outside a selected value changes revision digest but need not change selected-value digest. Escapes or whitespace inside its exact lexical bytes change that digest.

contract_cases.trigger: Duplicate decoded JSON key outside selected subtree
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Validate the whole JSON document, including escaped-equivalent decoded object keys, even for an empty affected list or a root selection.
Verify source and selected bytes before a successful dossier; preserve prior output on failure.
Use C25 unasserted occurrence/reifier terms. Check accepted affectedBy in default and named graphs, without any review/availability receipts.
Same inputs, methods, roots, limits and fixed clock yield byte-identical outputs. This is not restart-safe C26 publication.
Reject event with more than one recognized event type.
Reject nonempty event sequence without introduction.

contract_cases.trigger: Fixed and last_affected occur in same sequence
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Within a single events array, fixed and last_affected are mutually exclusive. Separate ranges may use either.

contract_cases.trigger: Opposite transitions at equal precedence, except valid introduced/last_affected singleton
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: After precedence sorting, reject ambiguous ties except a single introduced/last_affected singleton. Apply introduction first at that tie; limits are separately evaluated guards.

contract_cases.trigger: Reversed/empty interval or overlapping SEMVER ranges
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Sort first. Reject invalid sorted transition structure, empty effective interval, and pairwise overlapping SEMVER sets. This is stricter than OSV evaluation, not an OSV MUST. Source-order reversal alone is not invalid.

contract_cases.trigger: GIT/ECOSYSTEM range or schema other than pinned 1.9.2
contract_cases.adjudicated_rationale: Split outcomes: schema other than exact 1.9.2 is explicit unsupported-input with no complete dossier; structurally valid GIT/ECOSYSTEM range preserves entry and unknown branch membership. No unsupported branch yields a negative.
